2607.08255.title: Compete Then Collaborate: Frontier AI Teachers Build a Verifiable Curriculum to Improve a Coding Student Beyond Imitation
2607.08255.paper_summary: Large language models increasingly serve as teachers generating training data for smaller students. Prior multi-teacher knowledge distillation methods merge outputs without determining which frontier model teaches best, often relying on an LLM judge biased toward its own outputs. We introduce a compete-then-collaborate framework where four frontier AI teachers (Claude, Codex-GPT, Grok, Gemini) are ranked head-to-head by an execution-based judge (unit tests and stdin-stdout checks) with fairness controls, and then collaborate to build a verifiable curriculum for a student (Qwen2.5-Coder). We report three findings. (1) Under execution verification, all teachers solve standard problems near-perfectly after self-correction (99-100%) due to a saturation effect, but harder competition problems separate them (Gemini 77% > Claude 69% = Codex 69% > Grok 50%); however, the robust student-side results do not depend on teacher ranking. (2) Imitation (SFT) on verified solutions does not improve, and can degrade, an already-competent student at 7B and 32B (e.g., from 76.7% to 72.7% on MBPP-test, and 5.9% to 2.9% on competition problems). (3) Using the same collaborative curriculum as a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) environment improves the student (from 5.9% to 8.8% peak on competition problems, a +49% relative gain), reversing SFT's direction. The value of AI-teacher collaboration lies not in pooling answers to imitate, but in jointly constructing a verifiable environment where the student learns by doing. We release a reproducible on-prem pipeline (NVIDIA GB10) with framework patches for running GRPO on a bleeding-edge stack.
2607.08255.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地充當教師，為較小的學生生成訓練數據。以往的多教師知識蒸餾方法在合併輸出時未能確定哪個前沿模型教學效果最佳，通常依賴於一個偏向自身輸出的LLM評判者。我們引入了一個競爭後合作的框架，其中四個前沿AI教師（Claude, Codex-GPT, Grok, Gemini）由一個基於執行的評判者（單元測試和標準輸入-標準輸出檢查）進行頭對頭排名，並設有公平控制，然後合作構建一個可驗證的課程供學生（Qwen2.5-Coder）使用。我們報告了三個發現。(1) 在執行驗證下，所有教師在自我修正後幾乎完美地解決標準問題（99-100%），這是由於飽和效應，但更難的競爭問題將它們區分開來（Gemini 77% > Claude 69% = Codex 69% > Grok 50%）；然而，穩健的學生端結果不依賴於教師排名。(2) 在經過驗證的解決方案上進行模仿（SFT）並不會改善，甚至可能會降低已經合格的7B和32B學生的表現（例如，在MBPP測試中從76.7%降至72.7%，在競爭問題中從5.9%降至2.9%）。(3) 使用相同的合作課程作為具有可驗證獎勵的強化學習環境（RLVR）能改善學生的表現（在競爭問題上從5.9%提升至8.8%的峰值，相對增長49%），逆轉了SFT的方向。AI教師合作的價值不在於聚合答案以進行模仿，而在於共同構建一個可驗證的環境，讓學生通過實踐學習。我們發布了一個可重現的本地管道（NVIDIA GB10），並附帶了運行GRPO的框架補丁，以支持最新技術堆棧。
2607.08255.author: Miseong Shawn Kim et.al.
